hypothesis: ADR 0018's node lattice makes decoding measurably but negligibly slower. Stated before the run: the measured node/state ratio is 1.07x on real playing and Viterbi is O(T*S^2), so the cost should be well under 2x and invisible against spec 4's 60 s budget. Measured directly because the E7 column of the eval-m1 rows spans 0.0370 to 0.20 s per audio minute for equivalent work and cannot resolve it.
dataset: synthetic (500 single-note groups, chromatic cycle from A2)
notes: decode microbenchmark, no metric computed -- E1-E5 and E7 deliberately blank. Median of 7 warmed runs, each commit loading its own source via PYTHONPATH. 057deb8 (bare-state lattice): viterbi 5.5 ms, decode 53.8 ms. 013f1df (node lattice, ADR 0018): viterbi 7.2 ms (+31%), decode 57.9 ms (+8%). Re-run with scripts/bench_decode.py; lattice sizes with scripts/measure_lattice.py.

hypothesis: ADR 0011's span thresholds (4 frets below fret 12, 5 at or above) are too strict for real human tablature: well under 100% of human chord shapes pass, with span the dominant reason. Written before the run, in the script's docstring.
notes: E3 measured on the human reference tab itself, no decoder involved. HYPOTHESIS REJECTED: groups pass 0.9986 (0.9794 without the barre rule); 16,769,383 shapes; failures span 12,380 and fingers 11,633. Transitions 0.8835 as implemented, 0.8513 with the hand carried across open shapes. Exploratory follow-up on 2,000 songs: 82.6% of failing moves are <= 3 frets and 77.9% are between single notes, i.e. the speed rule counts finger reach as hand movement. Parse: 10 negative-fret and 193 string-collision groups dropped, 9 zero-BPM tempo changes ignored.

hypothesis: Maximum-likelihood weights fitted on DadaGP training beat the hand-set weights on DadaGP validation, on per-group NLL and per-note recovery of the human fingering, on identical lattices; high rises sharply against move. Pre-registered in scripts/fit_cost_weights.py.
notes: BASELINE: hand-set weights (move 1, span 1, high 0.1, open_reward 0.25). E2 here is per-note recovery of the human fingering on human notes, which equals exact tab F1 when every note is placed. NLL/group 0.7676. Exploratory split by part: clean 0.8097 (153,321 notes), distorted 0.5422 (376,611 notes).

hypothesis: Maximum-likelihood weights fitted on DadaGP training beat the hand-set weights on DadaGP validation, on per-group NLL and per-note recovery of the human fingering, on identical lattices; high rises sharply against move. Pre-registered in scripts/fit_cost_weights.py.
notes: FITTED on 600 training songs (469,363 groups), L-BFGS converged in 11 iterations: move 0.5772, span 0.7377, high 0.3767, open_reward -1.1483. NLL/group 0.4976. move:high per fret 120:1 -> 18.4:1 (6.5x, short of the predicted 10x). Disjoint halves: high differs 28%, recovery 0.6434 vs 0.6462. Exploratory split by part: clean 0.6963 (-0.1134), distorted 0.6251 (+0.0829). Adoption rule met on the pooled number, but NOT adopted as default: worse on clean guitar.

hypothesis: With the weights fixed, temperature scaling on DadaGP validation lowers the per-note calibration error; the fitted temperature is close to 1, so most of any calibration gain comes from fitting the weights. Pre-registered in scripts/calibrate_temperature.py.
notes: FITTED weights, temperature fitted by per-note NLL: T = 1.7210 -- NOT close to 1, so that half of the hypothesis is wrong. Calibration error computed as E5 computes it: hand-set T=1 0.2689 (NLL 1.5306); fitted T=1 0.1431 (NLL 0.8184); fitted T=1.721 0.0562 (NLL 0.7049). 59% of the 0.2127 reduction comes from the weights, 41% from the temperature. E2 is unchanged by T: the Viterbi path does not depend on it.

hypothesis: Replacing the hand-set cost weights with weights fitted by maximum likelihood on DadaGP training, and the temperature calibrated on DadaGP validation, raises oracle exact tab F1 on GuitarSet above the hand-set baseline of 0.6599 and lowers end-to-end calibration error below 0.3851. This is a transfer result: DadaGP is mostly distorted rock and metal tab, GuitarSet is acoustic jazz, bossa nova, funk, rock and singer-songwriter playing. It is reported against ADR 0016's M2 target of 0.760 but is not expected to reach it -- that target was set for a learned fingering model, not for four refitted scalars. Guardrails: E4 = 1.0000, E3 group rate not below 0.9970 oracle / 0.9896 end to end. REVISED BEFORE THE RUN, from DadaGP validation evidence and not from GuitarSet: the fitted weights recover 11 points less of the human fingering than the hand-set ones on clean guitar parts (0.8097 -> 0.6963) and gain only on distorted parts. GuitarSet is acoustic, so the revised prediction is that oracle E2 FALLS below 0.6599. The original prediction above is kept so the change is visible.
